scope:
Recover disposable Go-generated wallets through the Electron prompt protocol.

Three independent installations, homes and processes share only the recorded
phrase in test memory. This is a headless protocol integration; the separate
packaged drill operates the actual Electron dialogs. No original vault, keyring,
user secret, secret screenshot, or mainnet payment is used.

steps.name: Headless Go backend persists a random root and rejects wrong recorded words through typed Electron prompts
Password reauthentication and correct words enable all nine networks at indices0,1,127
Fresh independent installation restores all27 descriptors using only specified password and recorded phrase
Recovered installation starts locked and unlocks to the same wallets
Different local app password preserves every recovered wallet identity
Ordinary public-data IPC, persisted files and process logs contain no tested secret canaries

promptTransportException: Transient recovery phrase to isolated Electron dialog; input-only passwords/phrase/challenge replies to Go. Never snapshots/logs/files/network.
